column1: # Untitled Goose Game (Unity 2018.4.1f1 IL2CPP with FMOD on SDK 8.2.0, update 1.1.2 = v458752). Started from the NSP script's provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py); checked by
# hand against the survey on 2026-10-30: the modules (subsdk0 is the SDK's movie library; sdk is the build Captain Toad: Treasure Tracker and Link's Awakening ship), the 5 GB guest layout
# of a game with virtual address memory whose nninitStartup hands pool - used to StandardAllocator as one address region of 3.14 GB (sdk_patches.py cuts the node area on its sdk build, or
# the 1 GB-aligned region does not fit the alias region), the 16 MB system resource from the NPDM. Its shaders are the Unity 2018.4 Shader objects in Data/*.assets and Data/Resources
# (unityfs.py reads them with the 2018.3 layout), 4,511 of them, all translated. On Android it plays with these keys (android.tsv)
